name: Large-Scale Fine-Grained Image Classification Pipeline Template
summary: Reusable base CDG for Herbarium, iNaturalist-style, plant species, crop cultivar, plant disease, rare species, high-cardinality fine-grained visual classification, and scientific specimen image competitions that combine high-resolution or progressive resizing image preprocessing, EfficientNet-B4/B5/B6, Inception-ResNet-v2, Xception, ResNeXt-101, DenseNet-201, ViT-S/16, ViT-Base/ViT-Large, ConvNeXt-Base, or ConvNeXt ensembles, optional location/date/growth-stage covariate fusion or auxiliary heads, hierarchical taxonomy heads for family/genus/species, balanced oversampling or balanced fine-tuning for rare classes, MixUp and Random Erasing augmentation, pseudo-labeling from related prior-year datasets, label smoothing for uncertain labels, macro-F1 or class-balanced losses, cosine annealing with warm restarts, large-scale distributed TPU training, stochastic weight averaging, and calibrated class prediction.
dejargonized_summary: Prepare many high-resolution images, train strong image models, use taxonomy levels such as family and genus to regularize the species label, oversample rare classes, soften noisy labels, and calibrate predictions for a macro or long-tail metric.

inputs.name: fine_grained_images
inputs.constraints: High-resolution images, class labels, optional taxonomy hierarchy, source dataset IDs, and fold metadata.

outputs.name: class_predictions
outputs.constraints: Species, category, or fine-grained class probabilities formatted for macro-F1 or challenge scoring.

use_when: The task predicts one of many visually similar classes such as plant species, animal species, product variants, or scientific specimens.

Winning techniques include EfficientNet-B4/B5/B6, Inception-ResNet-v2, Xception, ResNeXt-101, DenseNet-201, ViT-Small/Base/Large, ViT-S/16, ConvNeXt or ConvNeXt-Base, ImageNet-21k pretraining, hierarchical taxonomy heads, location/date/growth-stage covariate fusion or auxiliary tasks, family/genus/species regularization, balanced oversampling or balanced fine-tuning, pseudo-labeling from related prior-year datasets, label smoothing for uncertain labels, MixUp and Random Erasing augmentation, progressive resizing from small to larger crops, HSV green-masking segmentation, CNN-MLP hybrid heads with handcrafted image features, cosine annealing with warm restarts, stochastic weight averaging, cultivar/source GroupKFold, or distributed TPU training.
The metric or data distribution makes rare image classes, taxonomy structure, and class imbalance load-bearing.
do_not_use_when: The output is a retrieval list or nearest-neighbor match rather than a class probability.
The main task is object detection or segmentation with masks/boxes as the primary output.
There are only a small number of broad visual classes and no fine-grained or long-tail structure.
applicability.key_insight: The durable topology is high-capacity image classification regularized by taxonomy and long-tail sampling. It differs from landmark retrieval because the primary artifact is a calibrated class distribution, not an embedding index or local-feature re-ranking.

swappable_stages.fine_grained_backbone_ensemble: Can use EfficientNet-B4/B5/B6, EfficientNetV2, ResNeXt-101, DenseNet-201, ViT-Small/Base/Large, ViT-S/16, ConvNeXt, ConvNeXt-Base, ResNeSt, or other strong image classifiers.
swappable_stages.taxonomy_label_assembly: Can use family/genus/species heads, growth-stage auxiliary tasks, parent-child label smoothing, hierarchy-aware losses, location/date/growth-stage covariate fusion, source-dataset indicators, cultivar folds, or covariate-conditioned heads.
swappable_stages.long_tail_regularized_training: Can use balanced oversampling, two-stage full training then balanced fine-tuning, class-balanced loss, class-balanced softmax, focal loss, LDAM, label smoothing, MixUp, cutmix, Random Erasing, pseudo-labeling, SWA, cosine annealing warm restarts, progressive resizing schedules, or rare-class fold weighting.

applicability.scaling_notes: Shard image decoding, cache resized images, distribute training across TPUs/GPUs, and keep taxonomy, cultivar, source-dataset, and prior-year pseudo-label splits leakage-safe.
failure_modes: Oversampling rare classes can overfit duplicated specimens if augmentation is weak.
Taxonomy heads can propagate incorrect family or genus labels into the species prediction.
Source-dataset leakage can hide domain shift between historical specimens or collection conditions.

planning_constraints.subject: taxonomy_before_model_heads
planning_constraints.statement: Assemble and validate family/genus/species mappings before defining hierarchical classifier heads.
planning_constraints.rationale: The classifier topology and losses depend on consistent parent-child taxonomy labels.

audit.rationale: Added after validation showed Herbarium and similar high-cardinality species cases were not semantically captured by landmark retrieval or generic image classification CDGs. Semantic comparison found the key missing contract was taxonomy-regularized class prediction with long-tail sampling, not embedding retrieval.
audit.dejargonized_summary: This covers fine-grained classification where many visually similar rare classes and taxonomy structure define the solution.
uncertainty_notes: Metric-learning identification tasks such as whales or landmarks should stay on retrieval/metric-learning CDGs unless calibrated class prediction and taxonomy heads dominate.

references.title: Sciona 135-CDG expansion validation audit
references.note: Local deterministic and semantic audit of unmatched fine-grained species classification patterns.

stages.name: Image Quality Preprocessing
stages.description: Decode high-resolution specimen, species, crop cultivar, or plant disease images, normalize source-specific quality shifts, resize/crop progressively such as 224 to 512 px schedules, apply heavy color/geometric augmentation and HSV-based green-masking segmentation when appropriate, and preserve location, date, growth-stage, source dataset, cultivar, or collection-period covariates.
stages.dejargonized_description: Prepare many detailed images without losing the small features that distinguish classes.
guarantees: Images are ready for high-capacity classification training.

stages.name: Taxonomy Label Assembly
stages.description: Build high-cardinality image labels, family/genus/species mappings, growth-stage auxiliary targets, location/date covariate features, source-dataset or cultivar GroupKFold splits, prior-year pseudo-label pools, handcrafted image features, and rare-class sampling weights.
stages.dejargonized_description: Organize the labels and taxonomy that the classifier will predict.

outputs.name: taxonomy_training_data
outputs.constraints: Images with taxonomy labels and weights.

preconditions: Taxonomy hierarchy is available or inferable.
guarantees: Training examples have consistent class, parent, covariate, and sampling information.

stages.name: Fine-Grained Backbone Ensemble
stages.description: Train EfficientNet-B4/B5/B6, EfficientNetV2, Inception-ResNet-v2, Xception, ResNeXt-101, DenseNet-201, ViT-Small/Base/Large, ViT-S/16, ConvNeXt, ConvNeXt-Base, ResNeSt, Mask R-CNN with ResNeSt-101, or related high-resolution image backbones, optionally initialized from ImageNet-21k, for species, specimen, crop cultivar, plant disease, leaf, garment, or fine-grained image discrimination.
stages.dejargonized_description: Train strong image classifiers that can separate visually similar classes.
preconditions: Backbone, image size schedule, and training budget are fixed.
guarantees: Model outputs preserve fine-grained visual distinctions.

stages.name: Long-Tail Regularized Training
stages.description: Apply hierarchical family/genus/species heads, growth-stage auxiliary task heads, multi-label attribute heads, CNN-MLP hybrid architecture with vision-plus-handcrafted feature concatenation, StandardScaler for handcrafted features, balanced oversampling for rare species, two-stage full training then balanced fine-tuning, class-balanced softmax/loss, weighted cross-entropy for rare attributes, focal losses, label smoothing for uncertain labels, pseudo-labeling from related prior-year datasets, MixUp, cutmix, Random Erasing augmentation, cosine annealing with warm restarts, stochastic weight averaging, and TPU/GPU distributed training.
stages.dejargonized_description: Handle rare classes and uncertain labels while training the classifier.
preconditions: Sampling weights, taxonomy heads, and metric are known.
guarantees: Scores are trained for rare-class and taxonomy-aware performance.

stages.name: Macro Metric Calibration
stages.description: Calibrate class predictions for Macro F1, average precision, logloss, or long-tail metrics using fold ensembling, Stratified 10-fold cross-validation, threshold tuning, source-dataset checks, stochastic weight averaging checkpoints, PointRend mask refinement, Soft-NMS for overlapping garments, and test-time augmentation.
stages.dejargonized_description: Turn raw class scores into predictions that respect the competition metric.
preconditions: Validation folds and metric are fixed.
guarantees: Predictions are calibrated for the benchmark scoring rule.
